text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Perubatan Tradisional dan

Komplementari (Bidang Amalan Diiktiraf) 2017.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Ogos 2017.

Bidang amalan diiktiraf

2. Menteri menetapkan bidang amalan yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual sebagai bidang

amalan diiktiraf.

JADUAL

1. Perubatan tradisional Melayu

2. Perubatan tradisional Cina

3. Perubatan tradisional India

4. Homeopati

5. Kiropraktik

6. Osteopati

7. Amalan pengubatan Islam

Dibuat 25 Julai 2017

[KKM-87/A4/700/4/2; PN(PU2)734]

DATUK SERI DR. S. SUBRAMANIAM

Menteri Kesihatan

TRADITIONAL AND COMPLEMENTARY MEDICINE ACT 2016

TRADITIONAL AND COMPLEMENTARY MEDICINE (RECOGNIZED PRACTICE AREAS)

ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 20(2) of the

Traditional and Complementary Medicine Act 2016 [Act 775], the Minister, after

considering the recommendation of the Council, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Traditional and Complementary Medicine

(Recognized Practice Areas) Order 2017.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 August 2017.

Recognized practice areas

2. The Minister prescribes the practice areas specified in the Schedule as the

recognized practice areas.

SCHEDULE

1. Traditional Malay medicine

2. Traditional Chinese medicine

3. Traditional Indian medicine

4. Homeopathy

5. Chiropractic

6. Osteopathy

7. Islamic medical practice

Made 25 July 2017

[KKM-87/A4/700/4/2; PN(PU2)734]

DATUK SERI DR. S. SUBRAMANIAM

Minister of Health
